name: io.github.jeanibarz/knowledge-base-mcp-server
title: Knowledge Base
description: Semantic search over local Markdown, text and HTML notes, indexed with FAISS embeddings.

environmentVariables.name: KNOWLEDGE_BASES_ROOT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Root directory containing knowledge base shelves (default: $HOME/knowledge_bases).

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider used for retrieval and ingest.

environmentVariables.name: HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hugging Face API token, required when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=huggingface.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Ollama server, used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key, required when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai.
